Annual Report 2025 - TechCorp Inc.

Executive Summary
TechCorp Inc. delivered record results in fiscal year 2025. Total revenue reached $4.2 billion,
representing a 15% increase over the prior year. This growth was driven primarily by expansion
in the cloud services division, which grew 32% year-over-year.

Key Findings
1. Cloud Services revenue: $1.8 billion (up 32%)
2. Enterprise Software revenue: $1.4 billion (up 8%)
3. Professional Services revenue: $1.0 billion (up 5%)
4. Operating margin improved to 24%, up from 21% in 2024.
5. R&D investment increased to $620 million, representing 14.7% of revenue.

Geographic Performance
North America remains the largest market at 58% of total revenue ($2.4B).
Europe, Middle East & Africa contributed 27% ($1.1B), with notable growth in Germany and UAE.
Asia-Pacific delivered 15% of revenue ($0.63B), led by Japan and Australia.

Product Highlights
The company launched three major products in 2025:
- CloudCore 4.0: Next-generation infrastructure platform
- DataSync Pro: Real-time data integration suite
- SecureEdge: Zero-trust network security solution

SecureEdge achieved $180 million in bookings within its first six months, the fastest product
ramp in company history.

Outlook for 2026
Management guidance for 2026 projects revenue between $4.7 billion and $4.9 billion,
representing 12–17% growth. The company plans to increase headcount by approximately 2,000
employees and open offices in Singapore and Warsaw.

Published: March 15, 2025
Certified by: Chief Financial Officer, Jane Smith
